title: Deploy: skip restarting ict-trader-live when the runtime diff touches nothing the trader loads (Phase 1, operator-approved)
note: OPERATOR DECISION (popup ~2026-10-15T10:10Z, relayed by manager session_01VduHYzdaXe27wTDBLSu8ao), verbatim choice: "Build it (Recommended)". SPEC = the TIER-2 PROPOSAL in the TELEGRAM-RESTART-MSG row note, Phase 1 exactly: in scripts/deploy_pull_restart.sh, restart ict-trader-live iff a changed path (diff vs the TRADER's deployed sha) is (a) a .py in the static import closure from src.main (AST walk incl. function-level imports + importlib.import_module literals; ~382 files on 2026-10-15), (b) any non-.py runtime path (i.e. not in the existing safe-set regex), or (c) a .py outside src/ and scripts/. Other units keep today's behaviour. Closure committed as a generated file plus a CI drift guard that recomputes it; a missing/unreadable closure file means restart. deployed_sha becomes per-unit: a trader-specific marker, so a skipped trader keeps its own older sha. src/runtime/restart_cause.py's describe_deploy range and the cause line, plus /api/diag restart_pending (src/web/api/routers/diag.py, lockstep test tests/test_diag_restart_pending_lockstep.py) read per unit. Deliverables: tests (deploy-gate tests alongside tests/test_deploy_pull_restart_runtime_gate.py); a replay over first-parent merges 2026-10-08T09:40Z..2026-10-15T09:40Z reproducing the measured split (879 merges: 711 non-runtime, 168 runtime, 42 skip / 126 restart; prototype closure + replay scripts were in the lane's scratchpad; regenerate rather than trust these numbers); hold PR, hold_reason tier_2_3_needs_approval. Phase 2 (comms data-file reader map) out of scope. Previous lane handed off near its $15 ceiling. LANE session_013LfwP31TKTdoH5kHsBUyry, 2026-10-15T12:25Z. MERGED #18285 at 11:24Z. DEPLOYED: the 11:27:43 ict-git-sync run (8d74f16 -> 0d7f23b) ran the PRE-MERGE script. Its journal has no 'Trader restart gate:' line and no 'recorded trader deploy marker' line (diag #18315), which is the expected one-off for the deploy that installs the script. Trader restarted at 11:28:28 by the old rule. Commits 0d7f23b..580ae92 are all non-runtime, so the new gate has not run yet. NOT OBSERVED: no gate skip and no gate-taken restart yet. BUG FOUND: /api/diag/version deployed_sha_by_unit was null for both units (diag #18314) because it read runtime_logs_dir() (the data dir) and not <repo>/runtime_logs. Fix in PR #18317 (Tier-2 hold). That PR touches diag.py (in the closure), so its deploy should be the gate's first run: 'restart (no resolvable trader deploy marker)', then the marker is written. trader_git_sha and restart_pending_by_unit read correctly (0d7f23b6f, false/false at disk 580ae92). Closes when: one 'Trader restart gate: restart' and one 'skip ict-trader-live.service (trader restart gate: ...)' appear in the ict-git-sync journal, and deployed_sha_by_unit shows a trader sha older than web-api after the skip. OBSERVED 2026-10-15 (lane session_013LfwP31TKTdoH5kHsBUyry; diag #18331, #18333, #18334). The gate ran and decided RESTART correctly on 3 runtime deploys: (1) ~12:2x (0d7f23b..eb4237e, no trader marker yet), which wrote marker eb4237e; (2) 12:41:51 'Trader restart gate: restart (eb4237e..7411968: non_py_runtime: tools/phone-executor/...)'; (3) 12:57:44 'Trader restart gate: restart (7411968..050c583: in_closure: src/web/api/routers/diag.py)', with the trader Stopping/Started at 12:58:26. /api/diag/version at 13:03Z: trader_git_sha=050c583fd; deployed_sha_by_unit = both 050c583 (non-null after #18317). NOT YET OBSERVED: a gate SKIP. That needs a deploy whose runtime diff is only non-closure src/ or scripts/ .py; per the manager, wait for a natural one and do not manufacture one. Also not read back: the boot 'restart report' cause line (truncated in the relay output). Closes when the ict-git-sync journal shows 'skip ict-trader-live.service (trader restart gate: ...)' and deployed_sha_by_unit shows the trader sha older than the web-api's.

observation.what: one trader-gate SKIP on a live deploy: the ict-git-sync journal shows "skip ict-trader-live.service (trader restart gate: ...)" and /api/diag/version deployed_sha_by_unit shows the trader sha older than the web-api sha
